recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD138 免疫染色中，大量細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色陽性，並在右下方聚成緻密片狀集落，其餘散在於脂肪間，代表漿細胞增加並形成聚集，支持合併漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Strong membranous CD138 staining in numerous plasma cells
Large, confluent aggregate/sheet of positive cells in the lower right of the field
Additional interstitial clusters and single positive cells between fat spaces
CD138-negative background hematopoietic cells with blue nuclear counterstain
Adipocytes and bone trabecula fragments at the edge
describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine highlights an increased population of plasma cells with strong membranous staining. Positive cells are distributed interstitially and in small clusters, and form a prominent confluent aggregate in part of the field, where they account for a substantial proportion of cellularity. The negative background cells include residual hematopoietic elements. In this field the plasma cell burden appears more than mild; quantitation should be performed across the whole core together with light-chain restriction studies. Findings support a concurrent plasma cell neoplasm in this patient with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered or perivascular without large sheets and show polytypic kappa and lambda expression.
LPL contains a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20+ B cells and usually MYD88 L265P.
Hairy cells are CD138-negative and are highlighted instead by CD20, DBA44, annexin A1, and BRAF V600E.
